### Added

- *(metatools)* Match a plural to its singular in filter_tools queries in [#1538](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1538) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(credprovider)* Answer the egress gateway's FetchSecret from Session bindings in [#1551](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1551) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)

### Changed

- *(make)* Pin govulncheck and let Renovate bump it in [#1552](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1552) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(ci)* Use architect orb 10.14.0 with the govulncheck scan in [#1556](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1556) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)

### Fixed

- *(ci)* Notify the homebrew tap on stable tags only in [#1544](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1544) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(agent)* Log an unanswered session close at debug in [#1549](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1549) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(aggregator)* Pin an issuer from its MCPServer definition in [#1554](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1554) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/compare/v5.43.7...v5.44.0
